t: This is Emanuel School in Battersea, a private, co-educational day school on a twelve-acre site close to Clapham Junction station. It was founded in 1594 by Anne Sackville, Lady Dacre, together with Queen Elizabeth I. Anne Fiennes, Baroness Dacre, is recorded as an English gentlewoman and benefactress, and she is named as the school's founder. She died in 1595, just a year after the school began.
